title: Hanen og høna i Nøtteskogen
placement: Each illustration belongs directly after the paragraph with index "paragraph" (0-based, paragraphs split on blank lines).

cover.caption: Tripp, tripp, tripp! Hanen løper så fort han kan.
cover.alt: Den hvite hanen løper av sted langs en mosegrodd sti i nøtteskogen med vingene ute. Bak ham sitter den lille, grå høna under en hasselbusk og ser etter ham.
cover.prompt: In the sunny Nut Wood, the Rooster dashes towards the viewer along the mossy path at full speed, wings flapping, feet a blur and a determined look in his eye, with the winding path stretching away behind him between the hazel bushes. Under a hazel bush in the background, the Hen sits in the moss and watches him go with hopeful eyes. Ripe hazelnuts hang all around.

Create the cover illustration for a children's picture book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: In the sunny Nut Wood, the Rooster dashes towards the viewer along the mossy path at full speed, wings flapping, feet a blur and a determined look in his eye, with the winding path stretching away behind him between the hazel bushes. Under a hazel bush in the background, the Hen sits in the moss and watches him go with hopeful eyes. Ripe hazelnuts hang all around.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Rooster: A proud, sturdy farmyard rooster, snow-white all over with glossy white feathers, a big, floppy, bright red comb, red wattles, a short yellow beak, round, earnest black eyes, strong yellow legs with little spurs and a tall, arching tail of long white plumes. He carries himself very upright with his chest puffed out, full of courage, and runs with his wings half spread.
- the Hen: A small, round, plump little hen, speckled grey all over with tiny white and charcoal flecks like salt and pepper, with a small neat red comb, a short pale beak, bright round orange eyes, soft fluffy grey feathers on her legs and little grey feet. She has a cheerful, curious, nut-loving look.

Setting:
- the Nut Wood: A sunny little wood of tall, many-stemmed hazel bushes heavy with clusters of ripe brown hazelnuts in papery husks, with butter-yellow leaves drifting down, a soft carpet of emerald moss scattered with fallen leaves and nutshells, a few mossy grey stones, and a narrow winding path leading out between the bushes towards open fields.

Story world: Old rural Norway, long ago, in the countryside around the Nut Wood, a sunny little wood of hazel bushes heavy with ripe hazelnuts. A winding path leads out of the wood to a small bubbling spring with a huge old linden tree on the grassy bank just above it, and from there on to the Virgin Mary's little cottage, the farms and barns of a village, a woodpile at the edge of the spruce forest, a smithy and, deep in the forest, the charcoal burner's clearing with its smoking charcoal stack. The red gold ribbons are shiny red silk ribbons with gold edges, wound on wooden spools. The little wooden bowl is a small, round birchwood bowl.

This story's season, light and colours: Golden October on a clear, crisp day: hazel leaves turned butter-yellow and drifting down, ripe brown hazelnuts, russet bracken and emerald moss under a deep-blue sky, in low, bright sunshine with long shadows. Accents: the rooster's red comb, the red-and-gold ribbons and the Virgin Mary's light blue. In the charcoal burner's clearing: soft blue-grey smoke.

characters.name: Hanen
characters.description: En omsorgsfull og modig hane som ikke gir opp før han har funnet hjelp til Høna.
characters.look: A proud, sturdy farmyard rooster, snow-white all over with glossy white feathers, a big, floppy, bright red comb, red wattles, a short yellow beak, round, earnest black eyes, strong yellow legs with little spurs and a tall, arching tail of long white plumes. He carries himself very upright with his chest puffed out, full of courage, and runs with his wings half spread.

characters.name: Høna (Tuppen)
characters.description: Hanen sin beste venn som får et nøtteskall i halsen, men blir raskt bedre når hun får vann.
characters.look: A small, round, plump little hen, speckled grey all over with tiny white and charcoal flecks like salt and pepper, with a small neat red comb, a short pale beak, bright round orange eyes, soft fluffy grey feathers on her legs and little grey feet. She has a cheerful, curious, nut-loving look.

characters.name: Kilden
characters.description: En klar, vennlig liten kilde som gir vann når den får friske blader.
characters.look: A small, round, crystal-clear spring welling up in a ring of mossy grey stones, about as wide as a cartwheel, fringed with ferns and blue forget-me-nots. On its gently bubbling surface a friendly face shows in the ripples: two round, shining bubble eyes and a wide, gurgling mouth. The water is so clear that the pebbles on the bottom sparkle.

characters.name: Linden
characters.description: Et stort og snilt lindetre som gir grønne blader når det får røde gullbånd.
characters.look: An enormous, ancient linden tree with a broad, rounded crown of heart-shaped leaves just turning from green to gold, a thick, gnarled grey-brown trunk and big roots like knobbly toes. In the bark of the trunk is a kind, sleepy old face: two knot-hole eyes under mossy bark eyebrows, a round knobbly nose and a wide, gentle mouth. Two low branches bend like arms.

characters.name: Jomfru Maria
characters.description: En mild hjelper som gir røde gullbånd når hun får et par sko.
characters.look: A small, soft, grandmotherly woman of about seventy with a round, kind, wrinkly face, twinkling light-grey eyes, a sweet smile and silver hair under a simple white linen veil. She wears a light-blue knitted shawl over a plain, long lavender dress, and on her feet only darned grey woollen socks, because she has no shoes. She looks like an ordinary kind grandmother, with no halo.

places.name: the Nut Wood
places.look: A sunny little wood of tall, many-stemmed hazel bushes heavy with clusters of ripe brown hazelnuts in papery husks, with butter-yellow leaves drifting down, a soft carpet of emerald moss scattered with fallen leaves and nutshells, a few mossy grey stones, and a narrow winding path leading out between the bushes towards open fields.

illustrations.anchor: «Vent her, Tuppen!» ropte hanen og skjøt brystet fram.
illustrations.caption: «Vent her, Tuppen!» roper hanen og skyter brystet fram. «Jeg henter vann!»
illustrations.alt: Høna Tuppen ligger i mosen og flakser med vingene uten å få fram et eneste kakel. Ved siden av står hanen med brystet fram og peker med vingen mot stien.

The Rooster stands tall beside her with his chest puffed right out and one wing flung towards the path, ready to dash off for water. Crisp morning light slants between the hazel bushes. Seen close up, at bird height.
